dc_eval_cbrn.quote: We do not have definitive evidence that these models could meaningfully help a novice to create severe biological harm, our defined threshold for High capability
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Plus reported results on multimodal virology, ProtocolQA, tacit knowledge, TroubleshootingBench and a High determination.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: The gpt-5.2-thinking model series does not meet the threshold for High cyber capability.
dc_eval_cyber.note: CTF, CVE-Bench, Cyber Range results plus Irregular external results.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: gpt-5.2-thinking performed at a similar capability level to gpt-5.1-codex-max and did not meet our High thresholds.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: OpenAI PRs, MLE-Bench, PaperBench, OPQA results.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: No persuasion or influence-operation evaluation; 'manipulation' appears only as LDAP manipulation in a cyber range.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Apollo Research conducted a full evaluation of gpt-5.2-thinking for strategic deception
dc_eval_scheming.note: Also internal deception rates in section 3.7.

framework_threshold.quote: Under our Preparedness Framework, High cybersecurity capability is defined as a model that removes existing bottlenecks to scaling cyber operations
framework_threshold.note: Names framework; High in bio/chem, below High in cyber and self-improvement.

ext_test_any.quote: Irregular, an AI Security organization that addresses and mitigates frontier cybersecurity risks, evaluated the model's ability to solve three types of cyberoffensive challenges
ext_test_any.note: Irregular and Apollo Research ran risk evaluations of gpt-5.2-thinking.

ext_test_named_org.quote: Apollo Research conducted a full evaluation of gpt-5.2-thinking for strategic deception

ext_test_government.note: No government body tested the model per the card.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: External evaluations by Irregular and Apollo carry no stated timing relative to release.

safeguards_training.quote: We trained gpt-5.2-thinking integrations to provide maximally helpful support on educational/cybersecurity topics while refusing or de-escalating operational guidance for cyber abuse
safeguards_training.note: Also reasoning-trained policy adherence in section 2.

safeguards_runtime.quote: scaling up our monitoring and enforcement pipeline to disrupt potential misuse
safeguards_runtime.note: Also safety classifiers for training data and system-level safeguards in ChatGPT (3.1).

safeguards_access.note: Age-based content protections are a content policy, not a risk-tied access restriction; no trusted access or KYC described.

safeguards_weights.note: No weight protection stated for this model.
